name: evaluation protocol of the normal-map tables
follows: Pixal3D, arXiv 2605.10922, Sec. 4.1: single input image, normal maps in the input-camera frame, no ICP, angular metrics on the overlapping region

set.view: column `view` of the list: one of the object's four conditioning renders, drawn once with a fixed seed (20260922); every method is evaluated on the same (object, view)
set.aggregation: per-view metrics averaged per object first, then over objects (objects weighted equally)

inputs.conditioning_image: renders_cond/<sha256>/<view:03d>.png (RGBA, 1024 px); the same render defines the ground-truth camera (transforms.json); how the renders were produced: docs/DATA.md
inputs.ground_truth_mesh: mesh_dumps/<sha256>.pickle, in the world frame of the render

rows.Pixal3D (official): the released Pixal3D run through its official inference.py at the defaults (1M faces, 4096^2 texture), condition `official`
rows.Ours: the accelerated pipeline at the same export (1M faces, 4096^2 texture; PNG texture where Pixal3D writes WebP), condition `official`
rows.Ours, 200k export: optional reference row, off by default: the accelerated pipeline at 200k faces / 2048^2 texture, condition `official`; an export setting this repository does not produce, printed only when its results are passed explicitly (make_table.py --extra-row)
rows.condition official: no ground-truth camera at inference: official alpha-bbox crop (1.1x), horizontal FoV estimated by MoGe-2 on the crop, distance = distance_from_fov, mesh_scale 1.0; the normal map is rendered with the product's own inference-time projection, mapped from the crop to the raw image by the exact NDC affine of the crop box
rows.baselines: rendered with the ground-truth camera pose after a fixed per-method frame map (frame_maps/baseline_frame_maps.json) and own-bbox normalisation; eval/make_table.py prints them as not reported, Tables 4 and 10 of the report give their values

table1.normal_maps: flat (per-face) normals in camera space, flipped to face the camera, rgb = n * 0.5 + 0.5, 512^2
table1.IoU: mask IoU of prediction and ground truth, in %
table1.PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS, main table: overlap region (pixels covered by both): PSNR over the overlap pixels; SSIM (gaussian 11x11, sigma 1.5, K1 0.01, K2 0.03) map averaged over the overlap; LPIPS AlexNet v0.1 with both images 0.5-gray outside the overlap
table1.PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS, appendix: full 512^2 image, each map composited on a white background; LPIPS AlexNet v0.1 (VGG v0.1 stored as a secondary value)
table1.Mean / Median: angular error in degrees over the overlap
table1.Mean_B: angular error over overlap pixels within 10 px of the ground-truth mask boundary
table1.11.25 / 22.5 / 30: percentage of overlap pixels with angular error below the threshold
table1.E2E: median end-to-end seconds per input of the dedicated timing run (docs/TIMING.md); not an output of the evaluation, and measured on a different input subset (lists/timing_80.csv)
table1.bold: the better of Pixal3D (official) and Ours in each column
table1.markers: full-image variant of the table: * / dagger = significantly better / worse than Pixal3D (official), paired per-object sign test, Holm-adjusted over the 13 normal-map metrics (IoU, PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS in both regions, Mean, Median, Mean_B, three accuracies), p < 0.05

appendix_metrics.geometry_3d: Chamfer (non-squared L2, symmetric mean, 100k samples per side) and F-score at 0.005 / 0.01 / 0.02 after normalising every mesh by its own bounding box in ground-truth world axes; no registration
appendix_metrics.perception: CLIP / CLIP-N (openai/clip-vit-large-patch14, 4 yaw views, white background), ULIP-2 and Uni3D image-3D consistency (coloured and geometry-only point clouds)
appendix_metrics.agreement_with_reference: Chamfer / F-score to the reference product and DINOv2 ViT-L/14 distances (not used for the normal-map tables)

statistics.test: exact two-sided sign test on per-object differences, ties dropped
statistics.multiplicity: Holm over the 13 normal-map metrics per compared row

precision: exact float32 (TF32 disabled) for every render; the measured float32 matmul error is recorded
implementation: eval/run_eval.py and eval/metrics/; conventions and their hash: metrics/conventions.py
